name: Read Extract Plot Agent
description: Extracts a table from an uploaded markdown document and plots its columns.

skills.name: Extract Table
skills.description: Reads an uploaded markdown document, finds the table that matches a description, and returns it as a JSON table artifact.
skills.usage_notes: Use this skill first, when the user uploads a markdown (.md) document and wants a table pulled out of it. It does not draw anything. To plot the table, call plot_table afterwards with the table_artifact_id this skill returns.
skills.output_format: JSON with keys: status, table_artifact_id, caption, columns, row_count

document_artifact_id.description: The uploaded markdown (.md) document that contains the table.

table_description.description: Text describing which table to find, e.g. 'the table with population data'.

skills.name: Plot Table
skills.description: Plots columns of a table that extract_table produced and returns the plot as a PNG artifact.
skills.usage_notes: Use this skill only after extract_table has produced a table artifact in this conversation. Pass that table's artifact id, the column for the x axis, and one or more columns for the y axis. Do not use it on a raw document; extract the table first.
skills.output_format: JSON with keys: status, artifact_id, chart_type, x_column, y_columns

table_artifact_id.description: The table artifact returned by extract_table (its table_artifact_id).

x_column.description: Name of the column to use for the x axis, exactly as it appears in the table's columns.

y_columns.description: One or more column names to plot on the y axis, exactly as they appear in the table's columns.

chart_type.description: Kind of chart to draw. Defaults to 'line'.
